title: r4 pause-on-open blocker only half-closed: settings_pause_on_open pins the pure proc, but nothing drives effect_settings — deleting the call site in main.odin still passes CI
detail: The extraction is the right architecture (pure decision, unit-pinned), but the r4 blocker's failure mode — the app effect silently dropping the pause — is still unpinned; parity wires counters, not the flip.
recommended_fix: Add one exec/app-level test that fires on_settings with mode=.Run and asserts the mode flips, or have parity assert the recorded mode.

title: Workflow mirror still broken: ci.yml runs only `odin test core` while the local gate-2 suite runs core + app + render + audio + harness
evidence:
- name: Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)
        run: odin test core
detail: Every r4/r5 pin (settings contract, hud rounding, QoS geometry, pause rule) is invisible to remote CI once Actions is unblocked.
recommended_fix: Mirror the gate-2 command into the workflow step.

title: demolish_button_rect keeps an unscaled nil-view fallback and parity calls THAT branch
detail: Latent second geometry the app never draws; at any future parity scale != 1.00 the twin diverges from the app hit-test.
recommended_fix: Require the view parameter; update parity to pass one.

title: Harness capture computes crisis banner_y from RAW constants while the app hud-scales it
detail: The scaled-banner AC is under-pinned: the golden capture and the app disagree on banner placement at x1.25/x1.50.
recommended_fix: Route the capture banner_y through rnd.hud().

title: AUDIO row never persisted though effect_settings_adjust's contract comment claims every change lands in the settings file
location: app/main.odin:745-774 + app/settings.odin format (4 payload bytes: palette/motion/scale only)
detail: Mute state resets on relaunch while the panel frames itself as the persistence surface; the dead settings_save call documents an untrue contract.
recommended_fix: Persist the mute byte (bump SETTINGS_VERSION) or fix the comment + panel copy.

title: Compiled Python bytecode tracked: tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
detail: Build artifact in the tree; stale-bytecode risk and diff noise against the palcheck derivation cross-check.

title: crisis_card_width hardcodes the forecast panel's 230/10 constants — cross-module layout knowledge
evidence: forecast_left := v.win_w - hud(v, 230) - hud(v, 10) // the forecast panel's left edge
detail: crisis.odin embeds forecast.odin's private geometry; a forecast resize silently breaks the clamp's spacing invariant.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared FORECAST_W/pad constant or a forecast_left() proc in forecast.odin.

title: Crisis-outline swell duplicates the reduced-motion pin inline instead of routing through pulse_read (the documented ONE seam)
detail: pulse_read is documented as the single seam for motion gating; this second inline pin is a divergence trap for future animated consumers.
recommended_fix: Route the outline factor through pulse_read (or a shared envelope helper).

title: sla_row_rect leaves x=8/width=740 unscaled in an otherwise hud()-scaled pass
detail: Row pitch scales but the hit-target extent does not; at x1.50 long row text overflows the focus/click rect.
recommended_fix: hud() the x and width too.
